When will I use this?

Percentages: when will I use this?

Every time a price, a strength or a limit is 'per hundred'.

Plumber

Construction and the built environment

\(\pounds 350 \times 1.2 = \pounds 420\)

A VAT-registered plumber adds 20% VAT to the bill. To add 20%, multiply by 1.2. The job costs £350 before VAT.

  1. \(\pounds 350 \times 1.2 = \pounds 420\).
  2. The VAT is £70.

Electrician

Construction and the built environment

\(5.4 \div 230 \times 100 = 2.3\%\)

Voltage drops along a long cable. The wiring rules (BS 7671) allow at most 3% on a lighting circuit and 5% on others. The UK supply is 230 V.

  1. Most allowed on lighting: \(3\% \text{ of } 230 = 0.03 \times 230 = 6.9\) V.
  2. A lighting circuit drops 5.4 V. As a percentage: \(5.4 \div 230 \times 100 = 2.3\%\).
  3. 2.3% is under 3%, so it passes.

Baker

Catering and hospitality

\(0.7 \times 500 = 350\) g of water

Bakers write recipes in "baker's percentages": the flour is always 100%, and everything else is a percentage of the flour's weight. A dough is 70% water and 2% salt. You use 500 g of flour.

  1. Water: \(70\% \text{ of } 500 = 0.7 \times 500 = 350\) g.
  2. Salt: \(2\% \text{ of } 500 = 0.02 \times 500 = 10\) g.

Jeweller

Creative and design

\(4 \times 0.375 = 1.5\) g of gold

Gold is measured in carats out of 24. 9 carat gold is 9 parts gold in 24. The UK hallmark writes it as 375: 375 parts gold in every 1000.

  1. \(9 \div 24 = 0.375\), which is 37.5%.
  2. A 9 carat ring weighs 4 g. Gold in it: \(4 \times 0.375 = 1.5\) g.

Practise it

Games on MaffsGames that practise percentages:

  • Percentage Flip: Find percentages of amounts, from 50% of 80 to harder percentages, in a quick card-flip game.
  • Free Daily Pizza: Convert between fractions, decimals and percentages, and find fractions and percentages of amounts.

Sources

Every job and every figure that is not an example comes from a public page you can check.

  • Plumber: GOV.UK, "VAT rates" (rate checked 10 Nov 2026)
  • Electrician: NICEIC, "Calculating voltage drop" (Professional Electrician), citing BS 7671 Appendix 4; Skills England, Installation and maintenance electrician (OCC0152), route Construction and the built environment
  • Baker: King Arthur Baking, "Baker's percentage"
  • Jeweller: Assay Office London, hallmarking guidance
